artifactProvenance.projection: Allowlisted numerical observations only. environment.quiet: Coordinator-controlled quiet; not OS-wide exclusivity, thermal/power/frequency control or network isolation.

medianConvention: Arithmetic median: average the two central sorted observations for even n; no rounding until presentation. Native finite pages only; never stress-copy or remount pages.

renderer.scope: Existing unchanged base-ui DataTable; JSDOM/Vitest 4.0.18, not pixels, IPC or native WebView

hostQueryEvaluations.reason: No production query engine in selected source; provider copied-row counts are not evaluations

queryLeases.reason: No query lease API in selected source

availability.hostRetainedHeap: Actual host devcontrol-only private Unix sampler; explicit post-GC snapshots outside timed phases, with sampling overhead recorded

hostForwardingRefcounts.reason: No measurement getter; runtime hook unmount and actual unsubscribe requests are observed separately

nativeWebView.reason: Chromium CDP does not measure native WebView paint/input

sourceStreamCount.reason: Provider watches count Watch lifetimes, not host gRPC event-listener streams

productionGroupsExpansion.reason: Default Resources view does not configure these; diagnostic DataTable-only models measured separately

availability.bridgeBytes: HTTP encoded transfer bytes + serialized request payload bytes and WS payload bytes; no TLS/socket framing or gRPC protobuf-byte claim
availability.numericTransport: Actual decoded SDK Struct/JS bodies recorded; canonical raw JSON is never transported out of band to hide rounding
availability.paint: Visible table + two requestAnimationFrame opportunities; not compositor pixel latency
availability.stressIdentity: Repeated unmodified canonical payload copies, indexed by diagnostic copy ordinal, not new native identities
availability.sourceNetwork: Fixture implementation has no source networking; clean HOME is not host egress isolation

laterCorrection.status: Root-component ownership cleanup correction is source-only and awaiting coordinator verification. These historical timings were not rerun, replaced or relabeled as corrected-source measurements.
